Shop speaker: Welcome to Luxora Premium! Where high quality meets high prices!
“high quality meets high prices” What the hell is that slogan? Who wants to pay high prices?
Shop speaker: You’ve been automatically charged for a lifetime membership fee.
Shop speaker: The lifetime membership fee cost is:
Shop speaker: 1

Shop speaker: 100- 
100$? Not bad. Wait! It’s still going!
Shop speaker: 1000- 
Shop speaker: 10000- 
… 10k?! What the…
Shop speaker: 100000- 
Shop speaker: 1000000$ 
1 000 000$ membership fee?!
